answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 14314 Country: India Title: as salaamu alaikum mufti sahab . could u plz clarify me a doubt. people near my house go to dargha and bow their heads there and do nyaaz and other things and they call themselves ehal e sunnat my question to u is that is this right according to the islaam and other thing is that when u say ehal e sunnat do u refer to these people or just normal muslims (other than shias). Question: as salaamu alaikum mufti sahab . could u plz clarify me a doubt. people near my house go to dargha and bow their heads there and do nyaaz and other things and they call themselves ehal e sunnat my question to u is that is this right according to the islaam and other thing is that when u say ehal e sunnat do u refer to these people or just normal muslims (other than shias). Answer ID: 14314 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1016/819=L/1430) As per the Shariah, it is baseless to bow down head on graves and performing niyaz etc, rather these acts are unlawful and haram . Ahlus Sunnah are those who follow the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) and his Companions, especially the rightly guided Caliphs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
